title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
description: Demonstrates a VLM trained specifically to interact with computer GUIs — clicking, typing, navigating — by predicting actions from screenshots. CogAgent introduces a high-resolution image encoder (1120×1120) for reading fine-grained UI text, combined with a low-resolution context encoder. Achieves SOTA on GUI-grounding and web agent benchmarks.
authors: Hong, Wang, Chen, Huang, Ma, Li, Lin, Tang, Zhang, Wang, Dong, Ji, et al. (Zhipu AI)
